description: This file defines a PHP class that modifies HTML attributes, specifically ensuring that script tags have a 'type' attribute set to 'text/javascript' if not already specified. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library, implementing attribute transformation logic for script tags.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_ScriptRequired
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform to enforce the presence of a 'type' attribute on <script> elements.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Ensures that the 'type' attribute exists on a <script> tag; if not, sets it to 'text/javascript'.
